reports.description: I was invited by Eric Cullins on Linkedin who encouraged me to start trading. He told me that the company he is currently working for will give me a huge profit and I can invest with as little as $300. He open an account for me on www.cryptoglobeline.com and asked me to log in there every day to see how quickly the money is growing up/ rising up. 2 weeks later, I wrote an e-mail to the head office that I would like to withdrawal all the money out of the trading account. Since that moment continuously I was receiving lots of different e-mails saying that there was another fee I had to pay. It was so suspicious to me as every e-mail I received from them had exactly the same story/Context such as ‚Äûas soon as you pay that fee we will transfer the money to you immediately/ in 24 hours/12hours/ few hours/ etc.‚Äô‚Äô. I noticed that after about a month later the guy who invited me on Linkedin removed his account. He only contacted me via WhatsApp when there was another fee to pay. I was so frustrated about the whole situation and so anxious. I decided to write an e-mail to the head office ‚Äì ‚ÄûPlease confirm that this is the last fee to pay and there is no more‚Äù. The answer was so clear from them ‚Äûthere are no more fees to pay, and that is the last one‚Äù. I paid that fee and Of course, they were lying! At the very end, as the last e-mail I received from them was ‚Äûyour account is on dormount/ is deactivated. If you want us to re-active that account you have to pay another fee‚Äô‚Äô. I replied to them saying the last e-mail from you it is a clear evidence that you are currently working on to transfer the money to my bank account, and there is no more other fees to pay. They warn me that If I don‚Äôt pay that fee Eric Cullins and me we will be in a big trouble. From that moment I stopped talking to them.

reports.description:
I was approached by a fellow Forex trader on Telegram to invest in a company called CLC Success Investments. I deposited $200 and made profit. I got excited. I then received an email from the company for a promotion but minimum deposit was $5000. The man who introduced me said he had been making investments with them for about 8 months and showed me proof that they were paying out. 
I made the deposit and waited the 7 day period. I then tried to make a withdrawal and was told by email that I needed to deposit another $1200 to activate the withdrawal. I did not do it. Many others started complaining they couldnt make their withdrawal as well._x000D_
They were registered on the ASIC (Australia Securities & Investment Commissions) website with an ABN# 86 126 858 366 and ACN # 126 858 366 as a legit business.  They have since de registered on 7/10/20 and their website no longer works.
